2.2 Background Verification
All new hires undergo background verification through ACME Corporation's empanelled agency. The
verification covers the following checks:
• Identity verification (Government-issued ID)
• Educational qualifications (highest degree and professional certifications)
• Employment history (last 3 employers or 7 years, whichever is earlier)
• Criminal record check (national database)
• Reference checks (minimum 2 professional references)
• Global Sanctions and PEP (Politically Exposed Persons) screening - for roles above Grade G4
  Important
  Employment is conditional upon satisfactory completion of background verification. Any material discrepancy
discovered after joining may result in immediate termination.
2.3 Buddy Assignment
Each new employee is assigned an Onboarding Buddy - a peer from the same or adjacent team who has
been with the Company for at least 6 months. The buddy is assigned at least 5 business days before the
new employee's joining date.
The buddy's responsibilities include:
• Reaching out to the new hire before Day 1 (optional welcome message)
• Giving a physical or virtual office tour on Day 1
• Facilitating introductions to key team members in Weeks 1-2
• Being available for informal questions during the first 90 days
• Completing a Buddy Check-in Form at Day 30 and Day 60
2.4 Workspace and IT Setup
The following must be ready by 9:00 AM on the new hire's first day:
